name: runtime-fit-both-workloads
argv: --command=set -eu; printf "BOOT_ID "; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf "DISK_UUID "; sudo blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/disk/by-id/google-remission-data; sudo stat -c "%d:%i %s %n" /srv/remission/data/remission.sqlite /srv/remission/data/remission.sqlite.admission.lock; sudo docker inspect --format '{"Name":{{json .Name}},"Id":{{json .Id}},"Image":{{json .Image}},"Status":{{json .State.Status}},"OOMKilled":{{.State.OOMKilled}}}' remission-simulation-app-1 remission-simulation-generator-1 remission-simulation-proxy-1; for container in remission-simulation-app-1 remission-simulation-generator-1 remission-simulation-proxy-1; do printf "metrics %s\n" "$container"; sudo docker exec "$container" sh -c "cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events"; done; free -b; df -B1 / /srv/remission; sudo docker stats --no-stream --format "{{.Name}} {{.MemUsage}} {{.CPUPerc}} {{.PIDs}}"; journal_status=0; sudo journalctl -k --since "2026-10-23 04:24:25 UTC" --grep "Out of memory|Killed process|oom-kill" --no-pager || journal_status=$?; printf "journal_grep_exit=%s\n" "$journal_status"; test "$journal_status" -le 1
